dedupe_keys.name: public hospitals in myanmar as of 2020 mimu

description: This layer maps the public hospitals of Myanmar as of 2020 as approximate centre points of each hospital or hospital compound. The producer is the Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU), with the points digitised by CDE Myanmar. Coverage is national. Locations were built from public reference lists and local knowledge and refined on satellite imagery at 1:2,000 to 1:5,000; for smaller facilities the point may be only the village or a best guess near the original coordinate. The data are available free from the Humanitarian Data Exchange as a shapefile and GeoJSON, but under MIMU's own terms: products are for operational humanitarian and development use, and publishing them on online platforms needs MIMU's prior written agreement, so this is not an open licence. Caveats: positions of small hospitals are approximate, the layer predates damage and closures since 2021, and no capacities are given. Simulation uses: exposure of hospitals to cyclones, floods and earthquakes, travel-time analysis to hospitals, and emergency medical planning. Related records: healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) and the HeiGIT accessibility indicators (data-heigit-accessibility-indicators) cover Myanmar from open data.
